name: Shanghai Zhongchen Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Zhongchen Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in research, development, production, sales, and services of electrical transmission and industrial automation products. It offers inverter, servo drive, industrial control, IoT, robot, and reducer products. The company also provides general machinery and power equipment, basic industry and heavy industry, special manufacturing industry, precision processing and automation equipment, and environmental protection and cleaning equipment solutions.
